cases.name: hs_cfa
cases.model:
# Holzinger & Swineford three-factor CFA
visual  =~ x1 + x2 + x3
textual =~ x4 + x5 + x6
speed   =~ x7 + x8 + x9

cases.name: pd_sem
cases.model:
# measurement model
    ind60 =~ x1 + x2 + x3
    dem60 =~ y1 + a*y2 + b*y3 + c*y4
    dem65 =~ y5 + a*y6 + b*y7 + c*y8
  # regressions
    dem60 ~ ind60
    dem65 ~ ind60 + dem60
  # residual correlations
    y1 ~~ y5
    y2 ~~ y4 + y6
    y3 ~~ y7
    y4 ~~ y8
    y6 ~~ y8

cases.name: growth_cov
cases.model:
i =~ 1*t1 + 1*t2 + 1*t3 + 1*t4
  s =~ 0*t1 + 1*t2 + 2*t3 + 3*t4
  # time-invariant covariates
  i ~ x1 + x2
  s ~ x1 + x2
  # time-varying covariates
  t1 ~ c1
  t2 ~ c2
  t3 ~ c3
  t4 ~ c4

cases.name: mediation
cases.model:
# direct effect
    Y ~ c*X
  # mediator
    M ~ a*X
    Y ~ b*M
  # indirect effect (a*b)
    ab := a*b
  # total effect
    total := c + (a*b)

cases.name: bang_comments
cases.model:
! a comment
f =~ x1 + x2 ! trailing
  + x3 # another

cases.name: tabs_cr
cases.model:
f	=~	x1 +	x2 + x3
y ~ f

cases.name: constraints_nonlin
cases.model:
f =~ x1 + a*x2 + b*x3 + c*x4
a == 2*b
b^2 < c
d := a/b
c > sqrt(2)

cases.name: defined_only
cases.model:
y ~ a*x1 + b*x2
ab := a + b
ab2 := a*b
ratio := a/(b+1)
